Trails' LookupContext resolves a template from a single controller prefix and format; it has no `_prefixes` list and no variant support, so `templateExists` / `anyTemplates` take only the action name. Converges with 0104-twitter-app-full-stack-integration/helper-methods-not-in-tse-scope, which rebuilds template lookup around an ActionView::Base-like view object.
